box: Box D -- 320px reflow. Real 320px viewport via session.setWidth (not --window-size, which does not reflow -- confirmed innerWidth === 320 in-page, per docs/agents/browser-verification.md trap 1). Overflow measured (scrollWidth/clientWidth/overflowingElements), not eyeballed, on the pick screen and the result screen, with a 10-person roster and the pair that renders the pool's single longest line for today's Bangkok date.
method: Solved offline first (node -e importing src/games/love-match.ts directly, Node 22's native TS-import support -- the same mechanism love-match.test.mjs relies on): computed the pool's longest line across all 31 lines in BANDS (67 characters, and there are two lines tied at that length), then searched all 45 unordered pairs among a candidate 10-name roster for scoreFor/lineFor on Bangkok date 2026-08-16, and found the pair (เจ, ปอ) draws one of those two 67-char lines on this date -- confirmed globally-longest, not merely longest-in-sample. Then drove the live page: session.setWidth(320, 900), wiped storage on-origin, re-asserted width after the wipe's internal reload, added all 10 names (ก้อง ฟ้า ตูน แนน บอส มิ้น เจ ปอ หมิว ต้น) via the named-entry path (all 10 auto-checked), clicked #start-round, measured the pick screen (10 chips rendered), then picked เจ then ปอ by exact chip textContent and measured the result screen. Overflow probe per browser-verification.md's calibrated snippet: `over = [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e => e.getBoundingClientRect().right > clientWidth + 0.5)`. Widest chip row computed by grouping chip getBoundingClientRect()s by rounded `top` (chips are flex-wrap) and taking max(right) - min(left) per row.
